Card Email us note.paragraph: We reply within one working day

style.Quick contact: background: #FFFFFF; padding: 80px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)) 0px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); gap: 24px; align-items: stretch; @media(--tablet){ flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 64px 40px 0px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; padding: 48px 20px 0px 20px; gap: 16px; }
style.Card Call us: flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 40px 32px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; background: #0B2F62; border: 1px solid #0B2F62; align-items: flex-start; transition: box-shadow 0.3s; &:hover{ box-shadow: 0px 18px 40px rgba(11,47,98,0.10); } @media(--tablet){ flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 12px); } @media(--mobile){ flex: 1 1 auto; padding: 32px 24px; }
style.Card Call us label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2.4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #E2BB6C;
style.Card Call us value: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF;
style.Card Call us note: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
